subject.title: feat(ui): sessions sidebar redesign with agent sections, smart groups, and draft sessions

question: After the correctness blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw adopt the full sidebar redesign and unified draft-session target flow as one permanent Control UI model?
rationale: The branch adds broad permanent navigation, gateway state, worktree, permission, persistence, and session-creation behavior under a protected maintainer label; code repair alone cannot settle that product boundary.

options.title: Review the full repaired stack
options.body: Keep the integrated design and require complete browser, cross-client, fresh-install, and upgrade proof before landing.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Land human-readable names and agent sections while deferring gateway-owned groups or advanced worktree and node targeting.

options.title: Keep the current model
options.body: Decline the broad redesign and extract only independently approved usability fixes into smaller pull requests.

recommendation.title: Review the full repaired stack
recommendation.body: Keep the integrated design and require complete browser, cross-client, fresh-install, and upgrade proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the canonical proposal, merged foundation, implementation branch, and recent sidebar feature history.
